Deriving a=(1-4z²)/((1-z)(1+4z)), lambda_c=(1+4z)/(20(1+z)), quadratic center coefficient B(z)(alpha-alpha_*(z)) with positive B, and monotone alpha_*(z) establishes the transcritical direction/stability. At alpha=alpha_* the explicit center-manifold correction w=Q(v)/kappa produces C(z)=-(16384z^10+8192z^7+6016z^6+964z^4+2888z³+361)/((1+4z²)(19+64z³)²)<0. Independently reconstructed the symbolic cubic via the source ODE and checked C(1/4)=-659/800, hence the stable t^-1/2 profile; near positive states the negative-sign transverse strong-stable direction cannot contain a positive state. This is local deterministic ODE science; no global hysteresis or finite-network extinction is proved.
